messages.content: Good morning. This is Kumar from CIMB Cloud Infrastructure team, customer id `cust-cimb-001`. We're planning to set up direct cloud exchange connectivity from our Cyberjaya DC to AWS ap-southeast-3 (Jakarta) — 10 Gbps initial, with HA secondary pair to AWS ap-southeast-5 (Kuala Lumpur). Boleh tolong start dengan discover exchange capabilities yang ada untuk kami?
Good morning Sir Kumar, thank you for reaching out to Cloud Exchange Provisioning Desk. I will discover the available exchange capabilities for your account. Please hold on for a moment.

messages.name: discover_exchange_capabilities
messages.content: {"customer_id": "cust-cimb-001", "capabilities": {"pop_locations": [{"pop_id": "my-cyberjaya-pop1", "name": "Cyberjaya CX-1", "available_ports": ["10G", "100G"], "redundancy": "diverse_path_available"}, {"pop_id": "my-cyberjaya-pop2", "name": "Cyberjaya CX-2", "available_ports": ["10G", "100G"]}], "cloud_destinations": [{"provider": "aws", "regions": ["ap-southeast-3", "ap-southeast-5"], "min_bandwidth_mbps": 50, "max_bandwidth_mbps": 100000, "hosted_connection_supported": true, "private_link_supported": true}, {"provider": "azure", "regions": ["southeastasia"], "min_bandwidth_mbps": 50}, {"provider": "gcp", "regions": ["asia-southeast1"], "min_bandwidth_mbps": 50}], "pricing_hints": {"port_10g_monthly_myr": 4200, "port_100g_monthly_myr": 31500, "cross_connect_one_time_myr": 1500}}}

Here are the available capabilities, Sir:

**PoPs**
- `my-cyberjaya-pop1` (CX-1) — 10G / 100G, diverse path available
- `my-cyberjaya-pop2` (CX-2) — 10G / 100G

**Cloud destinations supported**
- AWS: ap-southeast-3 (Jakarta), ap-southeast-5 (KL) — up to 100G, hosted connection + PrivateLink
- Azure: southeastasia
- GCP: asia-southeast1

**Pricing hints (MYR)**
- 10G port: RM 4,200/month
- 100G port: RM 31,500/month
- Cross-connect one-time: RM 1,500

For HA, I suggest CX-1 (primary) + CX-2 (secondary) for diverse path. May I check feasibility for your two 10G connections?
Yes please check feasibility for both — primary CX-1 to AWS ap-southeast-3, secondary CX-2 to AWS ap-southeast-5, both 10 Gbps. Run them in parallel sebab time-sensitive.
Certainly, Sir. I will run both feasibility checks in parallel.

messages.name: check_connectivity_feasibility
messages.content: {"feasibility_id": "feas-cb-001-pri", "feasible": true, "path": {"pop": "my-cyberjaya-pop1", "transit": "aws-dx-loc-jkt-01", "egress": "aws ap-southeast-3"}, "capacity_check": {"available_capacity_mbps": 240000, "requested_mbps": 10000, "sufficient": true}, "lead_time_business_days": 5, "warnings": []}

messages.name: check_connectivity_feasibility
messages.content: {"feasibility_id": "feas-cb-002-sec", "feasible": true, "path": {"pop": "my-cyberjaya-pop2", "transit": "aws-dx-loc-kul-02", "egress": "aws ap-southeast-5"}, "capacity_check": {"available_capacity_mbps": 180000, "requested_mbps": 10000, "sufficient": true}, "lead_time_business_days": 5, "warnings": ["cross_connect_panel_at_85pct_utilisation"]}

Both feasibility checks passed, Sir:

| Leg | PoP | Cloud | Capacity | Lead | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary | CX-1 | AWS ap-southeast-3 | 240 Gbps available | 5 BD | clean |
| Secondary | CX-2 | AWS ap-southeast-5 | 180 Gbps available | 5 BD | **CX-2 cross-connect panel at 85%** — proceed but capacity planning advised |

Shall I proceed with creating both connection requests and generating quotes?

Yes proceed for both. Commercial terms: 36-month committed, autorenew enabled, billing to CIMB Group invoice profile `inv-cimb-grp-001`. Technical config: BGP eBGP with ASN 64512, MTU 9100 jumbo frames, BFD enabled.
Understood, Sir. I will create both connection requests in parallel.

messages.content: {"connection_request_id": "creq-cb-002-sec", "status": "draft", "customer_id": "cust-cimb-001", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:18:12+08:00"}

Both requests drafted, Sir:

- Primary: `creq-cb-001-pri`
- Secondary: `creq-cb-002-sec`

Next I will generate quotes for both, in parallel.

messages.content: {"quote_id": "quo-cb-001", "connection_request_id": "creq-cb-001-pri", "line_items": [{"item": "10G port CX-1", "monthly_myr": 4200}, {"item": "cross-connect to AWS DX", "one_time_myr": 1500}, {"item": "BFD/jumbo enablement", "monthly_myr": 150}], "discount_applied": {"code": "CIMB-MULTIYEAR-26", "discount_pct": 15}, "monthly_total_after_discount_myr": 3697.5, "one_time_after_discount_myr": 1275, "valid_until": "2026-06-04T23:59:59+08:00"}

messages.content: {"quote_id": "quo-cb-002", "connection_request_id": "creq-cb-002-sec", "line_items": [{"item": "10G port CX-2", "monthly_myr": 4200}, {"item": "cross-connect to AWS DX", "one_time_myr": 1500}, {"item": "BFD/jumbo enablement", "monthly_myr": 150}], "discount_applied": {"code": "CIMB-MULTIYEAR-26", "discount_pct": 15}, "monthly_total_after_discount_myr": 3697.5, "one_time_after_discount_myr": 1275, "valid_until": "2026-06-04T23:59:59+08:00"}

Quotes generated, Sir.

| Quote | Connection | Monthly (after 15% promo) | One-time |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quo-cb-001` | Primary CX-1 | **RM 3,697.50** | RM 1,275 |
| `quo-cb-002` | Secondary CX-2 | **RM 3,697.50** | RM 1,275 |

Total MRC: **RM 7,395.00**, one-time NRC: **RM 2,550**. Quotes valid until 4 June 2026.

Shall I submit both orders for provisioning?

Yes, but before that — boleh evaluate customer-level policy untuk our account. CIMB ada policy framework yang require dual-region for any business_critical service, plus encryption at IXP. Saya nak confirm requirement dipenuhi sebelum order final.
Sangat baik, Sir. Saya akan menilai polisi pelanggan untuk kedua-dua sambungan.

messages.name: evaluate_customer_policies
messages.content: {"candidate": "cust-cimb-001", "verdict": "compliant", "matched_policies": [{"policy_id": "pol-cimb-dual-region", "hit": true, "reason": "primary ap-southeast-3 + secondary ap-southeast-5 satisfies dual-region requirement"}, {"policy_id": "pol-cimb-encryption-ixp", "hit": true, "reason": "encryption_at_ixp flag = true on both legs"}, {"policy_id": "pol-cimb-bcp-rpo", "hit": true, "reason": "diverse PoP CX-1/CX-2 + diverse path satisfies RPO < 5min"}]}

All three CIMB policies passed, Sir:

- Dual-region: COMPLIANT (ap-southeast-3 + ap-southeast-5)
- Encryption at IXP: COMPLIANT
- BCP RPO < 5 min: COMPLIANT (diverse PoP CX-1/CX-2)

Shall I submit the connection orders now?
Yes, submit both orders. Add internal comment also that this provisioning is for CIMB Q2 cloud migration project, ref `CIMB-CLOUD-MIG-2026-Q2`.
Certainly, Sir. I will submit both orders and add the project comment in parallel.

Quotes: quo-cb-001, quo-cb-002.", "visibility": "internal", "author": {"actor_id": "agent-cx-04", "role": "cx_provisioning_agent"}}

messages.name: add_customer_comment
messages.content: {"comment_id": "cmt-cust-cimb-991", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:30:13+08:00", "visibility": "internal"}

Both orders submitted and project comment recorded, Sir.

| Order | Connection | Task | Est. Completion |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ord-cb-001-pri` | `conn-cb-001-pri` | `task-prov-001-pri` | 28 May 2026, 5pm |
| `ord-cb-002-sec` | `conn-cb-002-sec` | `task-prov-002-sec` | 28 May 2026, 5pm |

Would you like me to subscribe your team to webhook events for both connections, and snapshot the baseline?

Yes — subscribe webhook ke our NMS endpoint `https://nms.cimb.com.my/webhooks/cx`, events: provisioning_progress, connection_up, health_degraded, suspended, terminated. Snapshot the customer state as 'cloud-mig-baseline-2026q2'.
Certainly, Sir. I will subscribe and snapshot in parallel.

messages.content: {"subscription_id": "sub-cimb-cx-001", "status": "active", "event_types": ["provisioning_progress", "connection_up", "health_degraded", "suspended", "terminated"], "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:32:14+08:00"}

messages.content: {"snapshot_id": "snap-cust-cimb-001", "customer_id": "cust-cimb-001", "purpose": "cloud-mig-baseline-2026q2", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:32:15+08:00", "retention_until": "2027-05-21", "storage_uri": "s3://cx-customer-snapshots/cust-cimb-001/snap-2026q2.json"}

Done, Sir.

- **Subscription:** `sub-cimb-cx-001` — 5 event types, HMAC-secured to your NMS endpoint
- **Snapshot:** `snap-cust-cimb-001` — kept 1 year

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Update — beberapa hari lepas. Provisioning team called and said primary task `task-prov-001-pri` hit a delay sebab fiber patch panel ada issue di CX-1. Boleh check provisioning task status untuk kedua-dua task, dan kalau primary stuck, monitor connection health untuk secondary supaya kita boleh swing traffic kalau perlu.
Certainly, Sir. I will check both provisioning tasks and monitor secondary connection health in parallel.

Status update, Sir:

**Primary `task-prov-001-pri` — BLOCKED**
- Step: patch_cross_connect
- Reason: patch panel port faulty at CX-1
- Vendor ticket: `INC-CX1-22018`, ETA repair **29 May 12pm**
- Progress: 70%

**Secondary `task-prov-002-sec` — COMPLETED**
- Online since 27 May 4:42pm

**Secondary health (last 60 min)**
- Link: UP, BGP established
- Loss: 0.001% / Latency p99: 4.2ms / Peak throughput: 1.84 Gbps
- Alarms: none

Secondary is healthy and ready to absorb production traffic if you wish to start migration. Would you like me to retry the primary provisioning at the vendor ETA, or shall we wait for the fiber repair?

Wait until vendor repair, then auto-retry the provisioning. Schedule the retry as a job for 29 May 14:00 (give 2 hours buffer after vendor ETA). Sambil tu, get the connection details for secondary for documentation.
Baik Sir. Saya jadual retry job dan dapatkan butiran sambungan sekunder serentak.

**Secondary connection details (`conn-cb-002-sec`)**
- Port: my-cyberjaya-pop2 / `xe-2/3/4` / 10G

Is there anything else I can help you with?
One last — boleh list all my connections under cust-cimb-001 supaya saya boleh confirm semuanya teratur, dan get audit history untuk this account from when we started conversation.
Certainly, Sir. I will list your connections and pull your audit history in parallel.
